name: Groundhog Tech MI pixel
author: randyhsu

sections.description:
Groundhog Tech MI pixel is a plugin designed to help you gain deep insights into website user behavior by injecting a tracking pixel, specifically tailored for WooCommerce stores. It enables comprehensive tracking of key user interactions to optimize your marketing and e-commerce strategies.

You can find more information about our Privacy Policy and [Advertising Privacy Policy] (https://mi.ghtinc.com/language/en/privacy-policy/advertising-privacy-policy-3)

Short Description

Groundhog Tech MI pixel is a plugin designed to help you gain deep insights into website user behavior by injecting a tracking pixel, specifically tailored for WooCommerce stores.
sections.installation:
1. Installing via WordPress Dashboard Search:
    • Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
    • Navigate to “Plugins” > “Add New.”
    • In the search box, type “Groundhog Tech MI pixel” and press Enter.
    • Locate the “Groundhog Tech MI pixel” plugin and click “Install Now.”
    • Once installed, click “Activate Plugin.”
  2. Manual Installation (Uploading the ZIP file):
    • Download the Groundhog Tech MI pixel plugin ZIP file from WordPress.org.
    • Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
    • Navigate to “Plugins” > “Add New.”
    • Click the “Upload Plugin” button at the top of the page.
    • Choose the ZIP file you downloaded and click “Install Now.”
    • Once installed, click “Activate Plugin.”

Once the plugin is activated, the tracking pixel will be automatically injected into your website pages, beginning the collection of user behavior data. Currently, all tracking settings are set to default and require no additional configuration.
sections.faq:
• What is the primary function of Groundhog Tech MI pixel?
    Groundhog Tech MI pixel aims to provide user behavior tracking capabilities for your WordPress website, especially for WooCommerce stores. This includes tracking events like page views, product views, add-to-cart actions, initiating checkout, and completing purchases.
  • Do I need to configure anything?
    In the current version, the plugin automatically injects the default tracking pixel upon activation. No additional user configuration is required.
  • What events does this plugin track?
    The plugin tracks page views (PageView), product page views (ViewContent), add to cart actions (AddToCart), initiating checkout (InitiateCheckout), completing purchases (Purchase), and search behavior (Search).
  • How can I verify if the plugin is working correctly?
    You can inspect your page’s source code using your browser’s developer tools to confirm that the violet.ghtinc.com-related JavaScript tracking code has been injected. Additionally, you can monitor your violet.ghtinc.com tracking platform to see if data is being received.
  • Does this plugin support e-commerce platforms other than WooCommerce?
    The current version is primarily designed with deep integration and event tracking for WooCommerce. For other e-commerce plugins, basic page view tracking will function, but specific e-commerce event tracking might not be supported.
